#Load GTF data ______________________________
gtf_path <- "data/gtf"# Path to GTFS folder
files <- list.files(gtf_path, pattern = "\\.txt$", full.names = TRUE)# Get all .txt files

# Extract clean variable names
varnames <- tools::file_path_sans_ext(basename(files))

# Loop and assign each file to its own variable
for (i in seq_along(files)) {
  assign(varnames[i], read.csv(files[i]))
}
